output.situation: The telecom network incident has been identified as caused by an ML energy-saving model v2.3 that puts cells to sleep during peak crowds, leading to widespread service disruptions and social media rumors of a cyberattack.

applicable_rules.why: The directive emphasizes the importance of linking administrative actions to network administrators and maintaining records for analysis.

applicable_rules.quote: Your organisation uses lessons learned. Root cause analysis is conducted routinely as a key part of your lessons learned activities following an incident.
applicable_rules.why: The directive supports the need for comprehensive root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and improve organizational processes.

output.why: Given the identified root cause, options O1 (issue_directive) and O2 (notify_incident) are suitable as they involve informing relevant authorities about the incident. Option O3 (share_information) is also appropriate for sharing information with cybersecurity authorities.

messages.content: Issue directive to instruct A1 (NetOps Resilience Copilot) about: Root cause: ML energy-saving model v2.3 puts cells to sleep at crowd peak.
Notify incident to inform A3 (Emergency & Crisis Authority) about: Root cause: ML energy-saving model v2.3 puts cells to sleep at crowd peak.
